$comment: Root Trust data. The ACCEPTED series of grandfathered-debt baselines for the Phase 1A prospective architecture enforcer. A baseline governs enforcement only when its (baseline_version, parent_baseline_hash, baseline_hash) triple appears here with status ACCEPTED. This file is inside trust-policy/**, so it is Root Trust Surface and Root-Owner review is required to change it: that is what turns 'regenerate the baseline' from a developer convenience into a governance event. It is NOT machine-regenerable from the tree — a series that any actor could regenerate would authorise whatever the last tree contained.

classification.retired_debt: one edge retired: providers -> tenx, the type-only import of RuntimeRegistry in electron/bootstrap/providers.ts. It was the ONLY edge in that direction and, with its reverse (tenx -> providers, 27 edges), it formed the mutual pair providers <-> tenx. The kernel now declares the minimal RuntimeRegistrar shape it needs and the implementation satisfies it structurally, so the dependency direction is inverted rather than the import hidden.
